text:
Yet because my emotional
program is
incomplete,
I did not even know
that Lady Ardylia
could smile like that.
Despite having served
at her side for years...
Kunon...
I wanted to know
how to make Lady Ardylia
say that she was happy.
I wanted to understand how
it worked and put it into practice.
But...
What you have told me
shows that I cannot.
So it is impossible
for a machine to understand
the emotions of living beings.
...
 That's not true!
 Do you really believe that?
 It can't be helped.
 That's not true!
 Do you really believe that?
 It can't be helped.
I think it can't be helped.
It's not
your fault, Kunon.
I make mistakes all the time
because I don't understand
what other people are feeling.
I make mistakes all the time
because I don't understand
what other people are feeling.
They are difficult
to understand, then.
People's feelings...
Yeah, maybe they are.
Yes, perhaps
they are...
That's not true!
I'm sure you
can do it too, Kunon.
That's not true!
I'm sure you
can do it too, Kunon.
You must be able to!
Do you have any basis for that?
Well...
Do you really
believe that, Kunon?
...
Can you accept that?
Can you accept
that it's impossible?
Well...
You're troubled, Kunon.
That's why you came
to ask me, isn't it?
Logic alone couldn't satisfy you,
so you came to me
for advice, didn't you?
You're troubled, Kunon.
That's why you came
to ask me, isn't it?
Logic alone couldn't satisfy you,
so you came
to me for advice, right?
...!
That's how a human
thinks.
That's how a living being
with feelings thinks.
Isn't that how
a human thinks?
I think that's how
a living being with feelings
would think...
